prompt: protobuf allow_alias enum all values distinct numbers behavior
answer:
If `allow_alias = true` is set but every enum value has a distinct number, the enum is invalid: allowing aliases requires that at least two values share a number. The protobuf Go descriptor validator reports:

> `enum "... " allows aliases, but none were found`

See the [Protobuf language specification](https://github.com/bufbuild/protobuf-language-spec/blob/main/language-spec.md) and the Go descriptor validation code.
